lines.en: I know the eggs along the fence.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴上有几道环纹。
lines.en: There are rings of dark on my tail.
I poke my head along the fence line.

lines.zh: 前面有个菜畦，我看了看。
lines.en: There is a vegetable plot ahead. I look at it.
People. I go around first.
I slip behind the woodpile.
I slip over the roots through fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 我停下来，用前爪扒了扒地。
lines.en: I stop and paw at the ground.
Insects. Not bad.
I go on along the fence.
My tail rides high, swinging.
A chicken ahead. I will not bother it.
I work around to the other side of the yard.
I crouch on the wall and watch the yard.
My forepaws are dark, and so is my face.

lines.zh: 我在想那口锅里的东西。
lines.en: I am thinking about what is in that pot.
Someone comes out; I duck my head.
He does not see me.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴裹住自己的脚。
lines.en: I wrap my tail around my own feet.
I smell nuts inside that tree hollow.
The wall is cool under me.
I shift to the other foot.
A cat is watching me from below.
I ignore it.
The cat has gone.
I go back to watching.
The sun has slanted. Time to move.
I perch on a branch, tail swinging.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来了，跟我一样高。
lines.en: You crouch down, level with me.
I cock my head at you.
No stick in your hand.
Then there is no problem.
I shuffle toward you.
My nose works at your shoe.
You smell of eggs.
I look up at you.
You do not move.
I come a little closer.
There's an egg smell from your pocket.
Not bad.
I do not leave.
That is a rare thing.
You probably know it.
You laugh, softly.
I rest my front paws on your knee.
Right beside you.
If you hold still, I dare look at you.
This while is good.
I yelp and bolt to the wall.
I press against it, still.
My tail is tucked between my legs.
After a while I put my head out.
Nothing stirs.
Only then do I come out.
One leg drags a little.
But it will serve.
I can still run.
This will do.
That is an egg.
I sit up at once.
I reach out a paw toward your hand.
You hold the egg high. I cannot reach.
I steal your food without a hint of shame.
Set it down and I will take it.
I run to the foot of the wall to eat.
I'll gulp that egg down in one bite.
When it is gone I look up.
The thing in your hand is waiting for me.
Back beside you, sniffing.
This time I rub against your leg.
Do you know what that means?
It does not matter if you do not.
Do you have more eggs?
Offer an egg and I am yours.
I will know you after this.
You're standing on my tail.
My paws slipped and I nearly fell.

lines.zh: 我扒着你的裤腿找吃的。
lines.en: I paw at your trouser leg for food.
You crouch down.
I pick my way back.
My tail still stings.
I hold it up for you to see.
You look, and say nothing.
Then never mind.
I sit beside you.
There is another beyond the wall.
We scent each other through it.

lines.zh: 我的面罩花纹，每只都不同。
lines.en: Every raccoon's mask is different.
I answer.

lines.zh: 我们绕着院子走了一圈。
lines.en: We walk a circuit of the yard.
We climb the woodpile together.
There is food here.
And places to hide.
Enough for the two of us.
Dawn is near. We part.
I scoop it over with a forepaw.
And hold it in both.
I look at it, and sniff it.
Edible.
I stuff it in my mouth.
I wash it clean in the water.
Can't swallow it — spit it back out.
This I will hide.
I hide it in a crack in the wall.
I will come back for it.
Something moves by the vegetable plot.

lines.zh: 我盯上了你腰间的小袋。
lines.en: I've set my eyes on that pouch at your waist.
A rat.
Not big, but enough for me.
I circle behind the fence line.
It has not seen me.

lines.zh: 我的爪子几乎没有声音。
lines.en: My paws make almost no sound.
It stops and lifts its head.
That string of berries sways in the wind.
It lowers its head.

lines.zh: 驯过的浣熊，贴着墙根走。
lines.en: A tamed raccoon hugs the wall.
It is foraging on the ground.
My eyes never leave it.
Its tail is moving.
I stop.
When it looks up, I stop.
Then it will not notice me.
It looks down again.
I squeeze inward.
My shadow hides in the wall's shadow.
I pounce and pin it with my forepaws.
It struggles under my paws.
I bite down.
Soon it stops moving.

lines.zh: 我一爪子抓在你手背上。
lines.en: I rake your hand with a claw.
Nobody else around.
I drag it to the wall.
And slip through the crack.
It is dark in here.
I pounce and bite your sleeve cuff.
I come out of the wood.
There is a yard ahead.
Chickens, vegetables, a woodpile.
This will do.
First I walk a circuit.
Looking for a way in.
There is a gap under the fence.
This wood smells safe enough.
I slip through and crouch at the wall.

lines.zh: 天快黑了，那才是我的时候。
lines.en: It is nearly dark. That is my hour.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的尾巴，我一头钻过篱笆。
lines.en: Fire catches my tail and I dive under the fence.

lines.zh: 我从墙头摔下来，落在菜畦里。
lines.en: I fall off the wall into the vegetable plot.

lines.zh: 水没过头，我扒着石沿往上爬。
lines.en: Water covers me; I claw at the stone edge.

lines.zh: 炸响把我掀翻，我滚到柴堆后面。
lines.en: A blast throws me rolling behind the woodpile.
My mask has a scratch across it.
The light pins me.

lines.zh: 好几天没找到吃的，我腿发软。
lines.en: Days without food and my legs feel weak.
Lightning falls and my fur puffs out.

lines.zh: 墙没了，我在黑里往下掉。
lines.en: The wall is gone and I fall through black.
